subject: Root package-lock.json: who owns it, commit or ignore?
body: Running 'npm install' at the root (needed for workspace devDependencies like typescript) writes package-lock.json at the repo root. validate assigns it to coord and fails as uncovered. I deleted mine and won't commit it. Please decide: commit a lockfile under a coord decision (and merge order matters as lanes add deps), or add package-lock.json to .gitignore. Exact output: 'ERROR: 1 file(s) owned by lane 'coord' are not covered by any decision: package-lock.json.' Also FYI: decide rejects titles over 120 chars ('$.title: longer than 120 characters'); fine, but the CLI help doesn't mention the limit.
